ocr.notes: Body correct; headline 'MRS. HARTGROVE LOST SUIT.' missing from the transcript and a stray garbage line at the end.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported that Judge Taylor refused Tillie Hartgrove, Tom Allen's nurse, a divorce; Allen had willed her his property except a nominal sum to each of his two daughters.

metadata.notes: Masthead: THE REPUBLIC: SATURDAY, MAY 23, 1903, page 8.

facts.fact: Circuit Judge Taylor refused Tillie Hartgrove, who nursed Allen, a divorce from her husband Martin, who she said deserted her soon after they married
Allen willed his property to Hartgrove, except a nominal sum to each of his two daughters
Had he recovered, Allen was to have married Hartgrove if she obtained a divorce, it was stated

notes: Says the nominal sums went to his two daughters; the facts index (000 line) says $10 to each of two sisters. The current summary is note-style, not house style.
